sloka: फल मूल अशनो दान्तैः चचार महत् तपः ।अथ अस्य जज्ञिरे पुत्राः सत्य धर्म परायणाः ॥१-५७-३॥
transliteration: phala mūla aśano dāntaiḥ cacāra mahat tapaḥ ।atha asya jajñire putrāḥ satya dharma parāyaṇāḥ ॥1-57-3॥

translations.english: For all the kings of the Ikshvakus race, their chief priest is their Guru. It is not possible to bypass the spiritual preceptor who is true to his word preceptor.
